title: [YouPass Collect] - Town Shopping Centre: Before & After

frame.name: Introduction
paragraphs: The diagrams illustrate the current layout of a town's shopping centre and the planned changes after a future redevelopment project.

frame.name: Overview
paragraphs: Overall, the most significant change is that the shopping centre will be modernised, with stairs being replaced by escalators on both levels. Additionally, while some retail spaces will give way to new facilities such as a supermarket and a cinema, the department store and ATM on Level 1 will remain in place.

frame.name: Body 1
paragraphs: Looking at Level 1, while the department store will remain in its original position, it will be extended by taking over the adjacent shop area, thus occupying a larger space than before. The ATM, meanwhile, will also be retained in its current location. The lift, on the other hand, will be moved from its corner location within the shop area to the centre of the floor, next to the cash machine. Moreover, the stairs will also be upgraded to an escalator, while the shops currently occupying the lower section will be demolished to make way for a new supermarket.

frame.name: Body 2
paragraphs: Turning to Level 2, more substantial changes are planned. The large retail area at the top of this floor will be converted into a new department store, occupying approximately a quarter of the level's total space. This new addition will also be accompanied by an ATM and a lift, mirroring the facilities on Level 1. Similarly, the stairs will be upgraded to an escalator, while the shops at the bottom of this level will be entirely replaced by a cinema.
